svg.title: Ротация плеча внутрь с резинкой — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing single-arm BAND SHOULDER INTERNAL ROTATION, front view. Right upper arm stays vertical against right ribs, elbow bent 90 degrees and fixed at waist. Band wall anchor on person's RIGHT (same side as working hand), at elbow height. Left figure: right forearm points out to right, fist beyond right hip. Right figure: forearm rotates INWARD across belly, fist near navel; elbow still fixed by ribs. Band connects RIGHT-side wall eye to right fist in BOTH figures. Opposite of external rotation; no overhead or side raise. Left hand relaxed. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
